title: General.
officialText: Occupancies in Group A shall comply with this section. Bleachers, grandstands and folding and telescopic seating, that are not building elements, shall comply with ICC 300. No place of assembly shall be located within 250 feet (76 200 mm) of any occupancy containing explosive contents.
